notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly with Void builds. The reprised Gridskipper is a Rapid-Fire pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "essentially just a worse high-impact auto". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and a ×0.8 reload animation multiplier when starting a reload with an empty mag as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are pretty decent by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/3176697589/gridskipper and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/3176697589 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is vertical but loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it, just go for extra Handling, and then with the magazine perk go for one of the combat effect mags or something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For Void build synergy and dealing with groups of red bar Minor adds, in the first trait perk column there's Repulsor Brace provides a ×0.5 damage resisting Void overshield for 8s (10s when enhanced) after killing a void-debuffed enemy - duration boosted by ×1.5 with Echo of Persistence, or Demoralize which spreads a ~4m AoE cloud of Void Weaken to nearby enemies for a ×1.15 boost to damage for your fireteam for 3s (5s when enhanced) on a crit kill. To pair with that in the second column, Destabilizing Rounds spreads Void Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 4.5s (5.25s when enhanced). The Splicer Surge origin trait stacks up to ×3 on a reload after doing damage, offering a max +45 to Handling and Reload Speed with a ×0.9 Reload animation scalar, which lasts until stow. If you're interested, the name has a dual meaning, referring to hacking the Vex Network's digital "grid" in Season of the Splicer but also, from the lore, as a paranoid defence against Vex Wyverns "skittering" and projecting shimmering outlines in the purple "grid" of the night sky. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 127 from 21 January 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/27QaoJnY0M7c7Ikhz8CbUv?si=397188c406294fcf) with @Saint_Kabr, @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing groups of Minor adds in general, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a void build. Gridskipper returns with updated trat perks, making it a decent choice if you're still looking for a void pulse rifle. At base, the stats are quite good - 33 Range equates to 31.41m ADS and 18.48m hipfire, 47 Stability, 27 Handling is 0.46s ready, 0.40s ADS and 0.45s stow speed, and 35 Reload Speed is a 2.14s reload (1.71s with the Rapid Fire frame intrinsic when reloading from an empty mag). The Recoil Direction of 55 is vertical but loose, so look to improve control with the barrel perk on controller, or boost handling on M+KB. The combat effect magazine perks are all here, and add utility, or Flared Magwell improves reload speed. For void build synergy the trait perk pairing of Repulsor Brace and Destabilizing Rounds work together to provide a Void Overshield using the volatility spread to adds through Destabilizing Rounds. The Splicer Surge origin trait is nice for PvE - reload after dealing damage for up to three stacks, which boosts handling and reload speed by 10/20/45 and applies a reload animation multiplier of ×0.967/×0.934/×0.9. Recommended MW: Handling, with a Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Void Breaches or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Gridskipper returns! Is it better than the previous version? I think so. But not by much we get some Void synergy through Destabilizing Rounds and Repulser Brace. But outside of that we don't have Rapid Hit or Subsistence for reloads. Perpetual Motion and Demolitionist are the only “reload” perks. Frenzy does bump you up to 100 handling and reload but that's only when the perk is active." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Within PvP Gridskipper Vs Claws of the Wolf is always an interesting discussion. Both have their merits and with the addition of Lone Wolf this season I'd give that edge to Gridskipper. Extra aim assist is always nice to have. If you wanted beefier stats you could forgo Headseeker for Elemental Capacitor for up to 100 stability AND Zen Moment AND the new Anti-Flinch mod for the ultimate anti-flinch the pulse." Recommended MW: Stability.
